report_name: CISA Completes Cyber Storm X National Preparedness Exercise

campaigns.name: Cyber Storm X
campaigns.description: A biennial national cyber exercise led by CISA, simulating a sophisticated nation-state attack on U.S. critical infrastructure, specifically the transportation and water/wastewater sectors, to test incident response and coordination.
campaigns.objective: Test incident response plans, improve coordination, and strengthen information-sharing channels between government and private sectors.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: The U.S. agency that organized and led the Cyber Storm X national cybersecurity exercise.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
identities.description: A U.S. federal agency that participated in the Cyber Storm X exercise.

identities.name: Transportation Systems Sector
identities.description: A U.S. critical infrastructure sector, including rail and ports, that was a focus of the simulated attacks in the Cyber Storm X exercise.

identities.name: Water and Wastewater Systems Sector
identities.description: A U.S. critical infrastructure sector that was a focus of the simulated attacks in the Cyber Storm X exercise.
